title: Regold data flows against canonical endpoints
description:
Regold the data-flow layer against canonical endpoint identities.

436 annotations, **424 distinct keys**, and every one a bare prose endpoint: `flow:user->stripe`, `flow:api-key->key_hash`, `flow:session->cookie`, `flow:password->wp_check_password`, `flow:failed-login->lockout`. No `type:` prefix on any endpoint, and many endpoints are not components in any graph sense. All 436 `subject.name` values are prose restatements of the key, so nothing is recoverable from that field either.

There is no mechanical migration. Every endpoint is resolved by hand to a canonical component or typed-endpoint identity, with data categories recorded as separate fields.

Also to fix while regolding: 419 of 436 annotations carry the generic label `data_flow`, which `LAYER_GENERIC_LABELS` auto-passes, so semantic classification currently has nothing to score against.

Critical path, human-bound. Filed as an `annotation` issue. Blocked on the data-flow disposition ruling.
